newsitem.title: USA: Wickes Q1 aided by training, market plans.
newsitem.headline: Wickes Q1 aided by training, market plans.

text.p: Wickes Lumber Co said Tuesday its first quarter net loss narrowed compared with last year because of its training, purchasing and marketing programs.

"We believe our training, purchasing and market expansion efforts all contributed to our improved sales and operating results," chairman, president and chief executive J. Steven Wilson said in a statement.
On Tuesday Wickes reported a first quarter loss of $0.63 a share versus a loss of $1.00 last year. Sales were $159.3 million, up from $152.5 million.

Same-store sales increased 3.5 percent versus the first quarter of 1996, and same-store sales to the company's core residential and commercial contractor customers rose 5.5 percent. Lumber inflation contributed an estimated $5.3 million to first quarter sales, Wickes said.
Wickes said its gross margin increased by 30 basis points and its provision for doubtful accounts declined by 20 points.
